title: Ayaa Hai Alaam
body:
Ayaa Hai Alaam
Alamdaar na aaya (5)
Aaya hai alam aur alamdaar na aaya
Daryaa se dil e hyder e karraar na aaya.
<<MINI>>
Aaya hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
1) baazuu Jo katey daanto mey mashkeeza dabaaya (2)
Jab mashq chidii Phir WO hayaadaar na aaya.
<<MINI>>
Aaya hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
2) har laash pey Bhaii ka madadgaar tha GAAZI (2)
Baad uskey koi shah ka madadgaar na aaya.
<<MINI>>
Aaya hai.....
<<DIVIDER>>
3) jab tak WO rahaa chaadar e zainab ka muhaafiz (2)
Qaimey ki taraf koi sitamgaar na aaya.
<<MINI>>
Aaya hai.....
<<DIVIDER>>
4) baazuu tha Jo Shabbir ka Bey baazu huwaa WO (2)
Bey dast WO Dast e shah e abraar na aaya.
<<MINI>>
Aaya hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
5) jis waqt tamaachey hai lagey Boli sakina (2)
Kya mujhpey Chacha Jaan tumhey pyaar na aaya.
<<MINI>>
Aaya hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
6) hai mujhko yaqee naizey pey GAAZI ko ye ghum tha (2)
Qabzey mey Merey shaam ka baazaar na aaya.
<<MINI>>
Aaya hai.....
<<DIVIDER>>
7) maangaa hai sakina key tawassul sey Jo mesum (2)
Salmaan dar e GAAZI se inkaar na aaya.
<<MINI>>
Aaya hai....
